question: How early before my slot can I check in from my phone?
reference_answer: From 60 minutes before the appointment time until 15 minutes after it starts.

question: My appointment was at 10 and it's now 10:30, can I still check in online?
reference_answer: No; online check-in closes 15 minutes after the appointment starts. Check in at the reception desk; you are then seen in order of arrival.

question: Is there a machine at reception where I can check myself in?
reference_answer: Yes, the self check-in kiosk at the reception: scan the QR code on your receipt.

question: I have no appointment today, can I still get into a doctor's line without going to the desk first?
reference_answer: Yes, you can join the doctor's queue from your phone in CareFlow if you have no appointment with that doctor today.

question: From what time can I join the queue online?
reference_answer: From 60 minutes before the department's OPD starts until 30 minutes before it ends.

question: I joined online, what should I do when I reach the hospital?
reference_answer: Reach the OPD desk before your turn and show your V token so staff know you have arrived.

question: What does a token starting with V mean?
reference_answer: V tokens are for patients who joined the queue online.

question: Can the receptionist push my mother ahead in the queue because she is elderly?
reference_answer: Only the doctor can move a patient forward for a medical reason; the reception can ask the doctor. The hospital may give priority to senior citizens.

question: They sent me to another doctor, do I lose my place?
reference_answer: No, you keep the time you checked in and get a message with your new token.

question: I can't wait anymore and want to go home, will that count as a no-show?
reference_answer: No; leave the queue in CareFlow or tell the reception. It is recorded as left without being seen, not a no-show, and you can rebook free of charge.

question: ऑनलाइन चेक-इन कब से कब तक कर सकते हैं?
reference_answer: अपॉइंटमेंट के समय से 60 मिनट पहले से शुरू होने के 15 मिनट बाद तक।

question: बिना अपॉइंटमेंट क्या मैं फ़ोन से डॉक्टर की लाइन में नाम लिखवा सकती हूं?
reference_answer: हां, अगर आज उस डॉक्टर के साथ अपॉइंटमेंट नहीं है तो CareFlow से कतार में जुड़ सकते हैं।

question: डॉक्टर इमरजेंसी में चले गए तो क्या मेरी बारी चली जाएगी?
reference_answer: नहीं, इंतज़ार कर रहे सभी को अनुमानित देरी के साथ संदेश मिलता है और उनकी जगह बनी रहती है।

question: डॉक्टर आज नहीं आए, जो लोग पहले से बैठे हैं उनका क्या होगा?
reference_answer: उन्हें उसी विभाग के दूसरे डॉक्टर के पास भेजा जा सकता है; चेक-इन समय के अनुसार जगह बनी रहती है और नया टोकन मिलता है।

question: कतार छोड़नी हो तो क्या करूं?
reference_answer: CareFlow में कतार छोड़ें या रिसेप्शन को बताएं।

question: ऑनलाइन रांगेत किती वाजल्यापासून नाव लावता येते?
reference_answer: ओपीडी सुरू होण्याच्या 60 मिनिटे आधीपासून ओपीडी संपण्याच्या 30 मिनिटे आधीपर्यंत.

question: चेक-इन केल्यावर टोकन लगेच मिळते का?
reference_answer: हो, लगेच टोकन मिळते आणि रांग स्थिती पानावर जागा पाहता येते.

question: T ने सुरू होणारे टोकन कोणाला मिळते?
reference_answer: दुसऱ्या डॉक्टरांच्या रांगेतून हलवलेल्या रुग्णांना.

question: गर्भवती महिलांना रांगेत प्राधान्य मिळते का?
reference_answer: रुग्णालय गर्भवती महिलांना प्राधान्य देऊ शकते; अपॉइंटमेंट असल्यास ते अपॉइंटमेंटच्या वेळेपासून मोजले जाते.

question: माझा क्रमांक चुकला आणि मी परत आलोच नाही तर काय नोंदवले जाते?
reference_answer: ओपीडी बंद होण्यापूर्वी परत न आल्यास 'न दाखवता गेले' म्हणून नोंदवले जाते आणि नवीन अपॉइंटमेंटसाठी संदेश येतो.

question: Can I reserve a place in tomorrow's queue tonight?
note: The documents describe joining today's queue only; reserving tomorrow's place is not covered.

question: Is there a separate fast queue for VIPs or hospital staff relatives?
note: No document mentions a VIP or staff-relative queue.

note: Swapping tokens between patients is not covered by any document.

question: रांगेची माहिती व्हॉट्सॲपवर मिळू शकते का?
